maddeler.e:
تستجهلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَجْهِلُوا (tastajhilū) /tas.tad͡ʒ.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# تُسْتَجْهَلُوا (tustajhalū) /tus.tad͡ʒ.ha.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
